name: Rust Development Tools
description: Installs Rust development tools: bacon (build watcher), cargo-edit, and cargo-audit.

install.description: Comma-separated list of tools to install (e.g. 'bacon,cargoEdit'). When set, only the listed tools are installed. When empty (default), all tools are installed.

omit.description: Comma-separated list of tools to exclude (e.g. 'cargoAudit'). When set, the listed tools are skipped. Applied after 'install' filtering.
